headline_finding: prezkopbuilders.com no longer belongs to Prezkop Builders. Every URL on the domain — including /about, /contact and all four service pages — now serves an Indonesian online-gambling site branded 'Bambuhoki88'. HTTP 200 across the board, so there is no 404 signalling the loss.

evidence.page_title: BAMBUHOKI88 Prezkopbuilders - DiKasih Cobaan Link Bambuhoki, Ya Cobain Langsung Duaar!
evidence.meta_keywords: Bambuhoki88, Bambuhoki88 LINK, Bambuhoki88 LOGIN, Bambuhoki88 DAFTAR, Bambuhoki88 RTP, Bambuhoki88 SITUS

business_impact: Any inbound link, business card, truck lettering, HBA of NEPA buyers-guide listing or old Google result pointing at prezkopbuilders.com now sends a prospective customer to a gambling site.
The BBB profile's 'Visit Website' button already points at a Facebook page rather than the domain, suggesting the loss predates this audit.
The domain's original URL structure was preserved by the squatter specifically to inherit Prezkop's existing search equity. Reclaiming or replacing the domain is urgent.
Brand-safety risk: the business name appears alongside gambling content in the page title, which is what search engines index.
what_the_old_site_did_well: Clear four-service structure with a dedicated page per service
Genuinely well-written service copy in the owner's own voice — specific about wood species, finishing process and building science
what_the_old_site_did_poorly: WordPress/Elementor build with an Astra theme — heavy, slow, and dependent on a domain and host the client has now lost
No service-area pages at all despite serving multiple Wyoming Valley towns
Lorem ipsum left in production on the remodeling service page
Contact was a plain WPForms form with no CRM, no booking calendar, no chat and no call tracking
No Google Business Profile linked or claimed
Portfolio images were the only proof of work and they are now unrecoverable except for 13 files preserved by the Internet Archive
recommendation: Rebuild on a domain the client controls. Content and imagery for the rebuild were recovered from the Internet Archive rather than the live domain — nothing on the live site was used as design or content input.
design_dna_used: NONE. Per pipeline rules the old site is operator reference only. The owl template is the sole source of layout and structure.
